title: Dual-write compatibility shim rollforward and customer migration runway
creator: Priya Nair
description: Summary: Prepare a staged deprecation path for legacy v1 endpoints by introducing a dual-write compatibility shim, SDK warning banners, and a migration runway for tenants. This ticket coordinates cross-functional deliverables: engineering shims and rollout flags, SDK changes and sample migration scripts, Console UX for migration status, release notes orchestration, telemetry gated rollout, and a concierge pilot for top 20 enterprise tenants. Goal is to reduce migration friction and preserve SLOs while driving >=80% automated migrations for self-serve tenants within 90 days of GA.
acceptance_criteria: Engineering delivers a dual-write shim with a feature flag to enable/disable per-tenant dual-write
SDKs (python/js/ruby) show opt-in warning banner and automatic hinting when legacy API is used
Console has a Migration Center page showing per-tenant readiness, migration checklist, and one-click migration for eligible configs
Migration CLI and sample scripts validated with 5 internal test tenants and 2 pilot enterprise tenants
Telemetry emits migration-state events and we have dashboard with weekly migration progress and error rate <0.5% for migrated requests
Release notes drafted and localized for EN/FR/DE with staged comms cadence approved by GTM and Legal
Concierge pilot runbook and SLA checklist completed for top 20 tenants and first pilot scheduled
tasks: Finalize shim API contract and per-tenant flags (ENG owners: runtime team)
Implement dual-write path that writes to both v1 and v2 stores with idempotency guarantees
Add telemetry hooks for write success/failure, latency, and divergence detection
Update SDKs to include runtime warnings, migration helpers, and sample code snippets
Design Console Migration Center flows and UX copy (DES review)
Draft release notes, in-product banners, and email templates for migration comms
Prepare migration CLI and sample terraform/snippets for customer infra
Run internal verification with staging tenants and runbook dry-run
Onboard 2 pilot customers with concierge support and capture migration feedback
Coordinate GTM: customer success, sales, legal, and docs for public GA
notes: Trade-offs discussed: realtime dual-read vs eventual-consistency shim; engineering prefers eventual-consistency to keep latency SLOs for host API
We decided not to block GA on full transparent rollback; fallback will be a per-tenant flag to disable v2 writes
Telem gating: start pilot with 5% of self-serve tenants then expand 25/50/100% by week windows conditioned on error rates
Estimate updated after design review: 8 points (runtime effort is largest portion)
Legal asked for explicit data residency note in migration docs for EU tenants
